answer: A concrete defense is proof-of-compute onboarding: each agent must burn real resources to climb the summit of a puzzle before earning a vote, and its identity sits on a ledge that resets on misbehavior. A lotus of instantly spawned clones costs the same compute per head, so scaling sybils scales the attacker's electric bill linearly. Because the barrier is per-identity and non-transferable, one operator cannot spoof a thousand votes without paying for a thousand proofs.
